messages:
liam: Quick heads up  the team running the node sample saw weird latency spikes when mixing embeddings + chat. Root cause looks like paginator + auth retry interplay causing bursts after token refreshes.

sophia: Do you mean refresh token calls are queued and then all clients retry immediately?

liam: Exactly. Sequence: auth refresh succeeds for 1 request, others get 401 then retry in tight loop. Combined with paginator concurrency it creates a short burst that trips per-org quota.

monica: Oof. That's an edge I hadn't considered. We should serialize auth refresh attempts and gate retries with a small randomized backoff.

rate-bot: quota-event: org=demo-123 limit=per_minute tokens remaining=5

sophia: Suggestion: add an auth mutex so only one refresh runs, others await it and then reattempt once with jitter. Also throttle paginator to honor a local token estimate.

liam: Proposed mini-patch: (1) single-flight refresh, (2) paginator: softCap concurrency when recent 429>2, (3) retry handler respects Retry-After and adds jitter. Pseudocode: ```js
await singleFlight(refreshToken)
if(recent429s>2) parallelPages = Math.max(1, parallelPages/2)
await sleep(parseRetryAfter(hdr) + rand(0,200))
```

monica: Can we make this opt-in for now? I want to avoid surprising teams that expect maximal throughput. Maybe default on for quickstart, opt-out via config.

sophia: Agreed. Quickstart should be conservative. SDK default can remain aggressive but expose toggles: `auth: {singleFlightRefresh: true}`, `paginator: {adaptiveBackoff: true}`.

liam: Filed issue #501 for SDK parity: python/node/go should expose same toggles. Added repro and attach logs.

rate-bot: support-ticket-count: 8 open tickets referencing "token refresh 429"

monica: I'll add a short note in quickstart README about these toggles and why they help onboarding. Also adding an e2e where we fake concurrent 401s to ensure single-flight works.

sophia: Nice. If we ship across SDKs and update quickstart, should cut these burst-related support tickets a lot.

liam: I'll open the quick PR today. Tagging @monica for docs and @sophia for SDK changes.

monica: thanks!
